statements.statement: The patient has a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and near-syncope
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The symptoms are intermittent and require continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R55
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
